sloka: यज्ञ विघ्न करी यक्षी पुरा वर्धेत मायया ।वध्यताम् तावत् एव एषा पुरा संध्या प्रवर्तते ॥१-२६-२२॥
transliteration: yajña vighna karī yakṣī purā vardheta māyayā ।vadhyatām tāvat eva eṣā purā saṁdhyā pravartate ॥1-26-22॥

translations.english: Kill her, for dusk is fast approaching. During evening the strength of rakshasas tends to increase and they become unassailable".
